description: This file defines a SwiftUI view modifier that changes the cursor to a pointing hand when hovering over a view, and restores the cursor when not hovering or when the view disappears.

classes.name: PointingHandCursorModifier
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that changes the cursor to a pointing hand on hover.

methods.name: pointingHandCursor()
methods.description: An extension method on View that applies the PointingHandCursorModifier.
